main.description: Lists indexed features with filters and direction-bound pagination; authentication is not required.

authors.description: Repository-owner DIDs; values combine with OR.

hasOrganizationRecord.description: Whether the author has an organization self record; false is independent of profile presence.

types.description: Exact open-string feature types; values combine with OR.

sortDirection.description: Direction for sorting by createdAt and URI.

limit.description: Maximum number of features in the page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page, bound to sortDirection.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter, page bound, cursor, repeated scalar, or query parameter is invalid.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when there is no next page.
